turn.context: Discharge sample conversation, turn 11 (playbook §6: the blank day to fill in, then redrawn with the real times).

transcript.label: Sample conversation · turn 11 · the trial times

text: Before the trial starts, I need your real times for one normal weekday. They become the starting numbers the trial is measured against.
Rough times are fine. If nobody writes a step down today, just say so.
chat.note: Rough times now beat perfect times never.

points.label: When the bed is ready again

prompts: Here are the times for a normal Tuesday
We don’t write down when doctors decide
Can the Discharge Manager collect these?
chat.pointer: Type a rough time on each step. Each one goes into your message.

blocks.title: One normal day, step by step
blocks.deck: Seven steps. Type a rough time on each one, straight into the drawing.

blocks.label: Times for Tojo
blocks.done: All seven in. Send to Tojo.
blocks.caption: The trial ward on a normal weekday. Rough is fine. Leave a box empty if nobody records it.

sheets.title: Doctor decides
sheets.text: The decision starts everything. If nobody writes it down, say so.

sheets.title: Doctor signs
sheets.text: The morning signature. Today every paper waits for it.

sheets.title: Papers ready
sheets.text: When the summary is ready to hand over.

sheets.title: Bill final
sheets.text: When the final bill is closed.

sheets.title: Insurance approves
sheets.text: For insured patients only. When the insurer says yes.

sheets.title: Patient leaves
sheets.text: When the patient leaves the ward.

sheets.title: Bed ready again
sheets.text: When the bed is clean and ready for the next patient.

items.title: Watch
items.text: Run discharge the usual way. Write down every time.

items.title: The new order
items.text: Start the papers, the bill and insurance on the evening round.

items.title: Decide
items.text: Compare the two weeks, then choose.

sheets.title: Watch
sheets.text: Nothing changes on the ward yet. The Discharge Manager, or a nurse you choose, writes down the times for each patient.

sheets.title: The new order
sheets.text: Doctors say who is going home on the evening round, as they already do. Papers and the bill start that evening.

sheets.title: Decide
sheets.text: We read the two weeks side by side and choose: spread it, or adjust and try again.

go.say: Here are the times for a normal Tuesday

add.detail: Tell me what you do not record

jump.detail: Back to what is really wrong
